_comment: Roadmaps for the homepage learning-path engine.
Every url must resolve on the live site. scripts/validate-selector.py checks
each one against the article, resource and pillar manifests and is part of
tests/run-all.sh, so an invented URL cannot ship.
A roadmap is seven steps: step 1 varies by experience level, steps 2-7 are
fixed per goal. The stage answer decides which step the visitor starts on,
so someone who is already live is not told to read the getting-started guide.
Step ids are derived from the goal and index and are what progress is keyed
on in localStorage, so reordering a roadmap resets only that roadmap.
